items.t: ‘I miss her like crazy’: Loved ones remembering post office worker hit and killed by car
items.x: Loved ones and a Kentucky community are mourning a post office worker who was hit and killed by a car while walking earlier this month.

items.t: Grandmother not indicted in baby’s death after police say she left him in hot car for 8 hours while she worked
items.x: A Madisonville grand jury declined to indict a Kentucky doctor after her 10-month-old grandchild died in a hot car, police said.

items.t: Rays ready for Game 5 after walk-off win extends World Series
items.x: Brewers remain one win from title as Rays face elimination Wednesday.

items.t: Democrats behind effort to recruit second Dan Sullivan for Alaska Senate race, new report confirms
items.x: Democrat Mary Peltola's campaign was involved in recruiting a man with the same name as Dan Sullivan to run for Alaska's U.S. Senate seat, The New York Times reported.

items.t: Ernie Johnson announces this will be his final season on ‘Inside The NBA’
items.x: Ernie Johnson announced he will be stepping down as host of “Inside the NBA” at the end of the season.

items.t: James O'Keefe charged after Minnesota polling station stunt
items.x: Right-wing influencers James O’Keefe and Cameron Higby were charged with felony counts of unlawful voting and identity theft, alleged to have claimed other voters’ identities while visiting polling places.

items.t: Police department closes its investigation into Hayden Panettiere’s death
items.x: The Greenville Police Department said it has officially closed its investigation into the death of Hayden Panettiere.

items.t: Windy Wednesday weather; Rain chances linger into Halloween weekend
items.x: It will be another windy day with scattered showers for the Gulf Coast.

items.t: TV personality Ernie Johnson says this will be final season on 'Inside the NBA'
items.x: Ernie Johnson, the longtime television personality and sportscaster, announced Wednesday that this will be his final season hosting "Inside the NBA."

items.t: Trump says US will beat China in AI as technology emerges
items.x: Artificial intelligence has emerged as the critical sticking point between the U.S. and China. President Donald Trump, who has named it “super intelligence,” insists the U.S. will beat China in the AI competition.

items.t: The science behind Jalen Hurts’ blood clot diagnosis is more complicated than it sounds
items.x: The Philadelphia Eagles quarterback played with a “superficial” blood clot that turned into something much more serious. Where did things go wrong?

items.t: DeSantis announces $100 million for 45 water quality, springs and water supply projects
items.x: Funding is split between springs projects and alternative water supply projects.

items.t: Alvin K. Hellerstein, a federal judge who handled Trump, Maduro and 9/11 cases, dies at 92
items.x: Alvin K. Hellerstein, a Manhattan federal judge who presided over matters involving President Trump, former Venezuelan President Maduro and the 9/11 attacks, has died.

items.t: Man accused of hit-and-run on Cape Coral canal marker that caused $1,000 in damage
items.x: A man was arrested after officers with the Cape Coral Police Department say he hit a canal marker and drove away.

items.t: Man loses more than $4,000 after scammers spoof father’s number, claim parents are at gunpoint
items.x: Scammers spoofed an Arizona man’s father’s phone number and claimed his parents in Virginia were at gunpoint. He sent more than $4,000 through Apple Pay.

items.t: 8-month-old dies after left alone in running bathtub, police say
items.x: A Virginia woman was arrested after her 8-month-old died after being left unattended in a bathtub, according to authorities.

items.t: How do FL’s top gubernatorial candidates plan to lead the state?
items.x: Election day is just six days away and all the political advertising may have people thinking, what would Florida’s top gubernatorial candidates actually do in office?

items.t: ReptiDay Sarasota returns Halloween weekend with reptiles, exotic animals and educational opportunities
items.x: ReptiDay Sarasota returns Oct. 31, offering a closer look at snakes, lizards and other exotic animals while helping visitors overcome fears and learn about reptile care.

items.t: Tom Jones postpones tour dates to recover from illness
items.x: The "It's Not Unusual" singer has been on his 25-date "Come Gather Round North American Tour" since the middle of September.

items.t: Federal Reserve keeps rates unchanged despite elevated inflation
items.x: The Federal Reserve kept its key rate unchanged Wednesday at about 3.9% despite elevated inflation, while providing little hint about the central bank’s next moves.
